tool_calls.name: bash
tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"cat << 'EOF' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      tolerations:
        - key: dedicated
          operator: Equal
          value: "gpu"
          effect: NoSchedule
      containers:
        - name: nginx
          image: nginx:1.31.5
EOF"}
